explanation: Contract expected from an IT-provided SAP S/4HANA integration service. These are NOT assumed to exist in SAP out-of-the-box.

value.fieldM: <Ms Tien column M result; no error>
value.declarationText: <optional content equivalent to Ms Tien column P>
value.reconcileDifference: <numeric delta per invoice line; together must sum to zero>

invoiceEndpoint.warning: IT must reconstruct relevant business rules of workbook columns B:P, T:AC; YINVLST may not directly contain contentF/contentG/fieldM/reconcileDifference. A normalization layer or custom SAP OData/CDS API is required.

fxEndpoint.warning: Resolve TCURR quotation direction, exchange-rate factors and decimal representation correctly. Do not treat raw UKURS as automatically VND/USD.
